coverage_decision: All main-text figures/tables were reconciled. All 11 supplementary tables and all 74 supplementary figures were inventoried and reconciled by semantic family. Quantitative extraction focused on load-bearing pooled, network, subgroup, and ranking results rather than reproducing every league-table cell.

omissions.reason: References are provenance infrastructure and were converted to a separate 50-reference task queue rather than atomized.

source_consistency_flags: HHF certainty: abstract/Table 2 low vs Results prose moderate.
Hypotension: supplement supports HR 1.17 (1.01-1.34); parsed main text contains an inconsistent 1.71 wording while describing a 17% increase.
eGFR: Supplementary Results S1/Figure S33 report +3.00 (1.71-4.30), while Table 2 reports a conflicting lower-direction value.
Authors explicitly note some RR Summary-of-Findings versus HR forest-plot discrepancies because CANVAS Program lacked event counts for RR calculation.
